profile.ja: 異世界からきた若きアサギ。同じく異世界からやって来て主人公の家に居候しているさくらの姉である。希少な異能系の忍法“隼の術”を操るくノ一。名門井河家本流の嫡子として次代の対魔忍たちのリーダーになる事を期待されるも、対魔忍養成機関である五車学園の入学を拒否、曰く「政府の犬になるつもりはない」と一般の学校へ通っている。得物は父の形見である忍者刀“悪鬼六文”。剣術“逸刀流”の免許皆伝の腕前だが、父の形見を悪の血で染める事を嫌い専ら格闘術を使う。忍者に伝わる格闘術“対魔殺法”その中でも足技による“刀脚”の使い手。彼女の忍法“隼の術”と組み合わせた刀脚は目に見えない超高速の蹴りのラッシュで 敵を一瞬で粉砕するという。
profile.en: ZER0 Asagi, she/her: She is a young Asagi from another world, the older sister of Sakura who also came from another world and is currently staying at the protagonist's house. She wields the rare, supernatural ninja art "Falcon Technique" as a kunoichi. As the heir of the prestigious Igawa family, she is expected to become the next leader of the Taimanin, yet she refused admission to the Taimanin training institute Gosha Academy, declaring, "I won't become the government's dog," and instead attends a regular school. Her weapon is the ninja sword "Akki Rokubun," a heirloom of her father. Though she holds a master's license in the sword art "Itsutō-ryū," she dislikes staining her father's heirloom with evil blood and prefers hand-to-hand combat. She practices the ninja combat style "Taimashihō," specializing in foot techniques called "Sword-Leg." When combined with her "Falcon Technique," her Sword-Leg delivers an invisible, ultra-fast kick barrage that pulverizes enemies in an instant.

text.ja: この度はご指名いただき、ありがとうございます。私、井河アサギと申します。以後、お見知りおきを……♪
text.en: Thank you for selecting me this time. I am Igawa Asagi. Please consider me acquainted from now on…♪

text.ja: じゃあ、ちょっと出かけてくるわね。ええ、このままよ。なにか文句でもある？
text.en: Well then, I'm stepping out for a bit. Yeah, just like that. Got any complaints?

text.ja: 居候させて貰ってる身だけど、私のすることに口を出さないでもらえるかしら
text.en: I'm staying here as a freeloader, but could you please not meddle in what I do?

text.ja: この衣装のことが気になるの？　ふふっ……趣味が悪いわね
text.en: Curious about this outfit? Heh… your taste is terrible.

text.ja: 背中の入れ墨……。最初は気に入らなかったけど、最近はそうでもないかな
text.en: The tattoo on my back… I didn't like it at first, but lately it's not such a big deal.

text.ja: それにしても……男の人の欲望って、際限がないのね
text.en: Even so… men's desires really know no bounds.

text.ja: どうぞ、ご自由に、好きなだけ、私をお使いくださいませ♪　私も、ご主人様に全力でご奉仕いたします……♪
text.en: Please, feel free to use me as much as you like♪ I'll also serve you, Master, with all my might……♪
